verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships its own agent, Pulumi Neo, so being able to plug in external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Pulumi's own MCP server, which serves tools to Cursor, Claude Code and other assistants. That is the server role and does not show Pulumi or Neo consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Pulumi acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
